newsitem.title: KENYA: Index down in higher turnover at Nairobi bourse.
newsitem.headline: Index down in higher turnover at Nairobi bourse.

text.p: Turnover at the Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) improved by about five million shares on Friday but prices eased marginally, dragging the 20-share index down in a very dull market, bourse officials said.
The index fell 18.24 points to 3055.12. Turnover was posted at 21.580 million shillings traded on 410,896 shares from 16.856 million shillings traded on 369,070 shares.
Brokers and bourse officials said the marginal price decrease was due to reduced demand on key shares.

Kenya Commercial Bank which jumped to 79 from 69 on Tuesday, shed 5.0 to close at 73. Brooke Bond shed 5.0 to close at 173. Uchumi Supermarket eased to 44 from 44.25. while Lonrho Motors closed at 121 from 123.
"I think the key problem here is that many investors are not willing to sell at such low prices," a broker said.
Kapchorua Tea accounted for about 69 percent of Friday's turnover. It traded 214,500 shares on the the three-day special lots board at 70 from 68.
A dealer said that considering the large volumes dealt in the last two weeks, the market appeared to be picking up.
"A normal market has its upswings and downswings. A lot of people are buying now, which means the business mood is coming back," he added.

Kenya Airways closed at 7.25 from 7.05 while Nation Printers & Publishers eased a shilling to close at 108 from 109. Bamburi Cement closed at 29 from 30, while Kenya Breweries traded at 50 from 50.50.
